spanish: Y alzó el pueblo su masa antes de leudar; sus artesas atadas en sus mantos sobre su hombro.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3ms after “before” is smoothed to the infinitive “leudar”; person is unmarked and the subject (dough or people, both 3ms) is less explicit, without a stem or event change.

notes: Remaining clauses match the tokens, including singular hombro with a plural possessor.
